statements: VC-26.1: "this repo would keep depending on the PUBLISHED solid-pod-rs crate (Cargo.toml:222, 0.4.0-alpha.15)"
reason: The commit bumps solid-pod-rs and its sibling crates from 0.4.0-alpha.15 to an exact =0.5.0-alpha.12 pin, and adds a [patch.crates-io] for nostr-bbs-core. Note4 therefore names a version the repo no longer depends on, and it describes the lockstep move as only proposed, though the pin is already in place.
